## Definitions

### stageLengthRule

Which stage-length rule was broken. warmup\_duration is the warmup rule (at least 2 x the interval and 30s) and carries no stage\_index; percentile\_sample\_count is Rule A and carries percentile and required\_requests.

Type: `"min_stage_duration"`, `"warmup_duration"`, `"percentile_sample_count"`, `"request_duration_ratio"`

### scrapeWarningRule

missing\_scrape\_role: Prometheus has no job with the role, so series of that role may be missing or scraped more slowly than reported.

Type: `"missing_scrape_role"`

### percentileName

Type: `"p50"`, `"p90"`, `"p95"`, `"p99"`

### stageLengthWarning

| Field                       | Type                                                                    | Required | Description                                                                                |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `stage_index`               | `integer`                                                               | No       | Absent for the warmup\_duration rule, required for every other rule. ≥ 0                   |
| `rule`                      | [stageLengthRule](/reference/schemas/phases/#stagelengthrule)           | Yes      |                                                                                            |
| `required_duration_seconds` | `number`                                                                | Yes      | The minimum length the rule demands of the stage (or of the warmup). &gt; 0                |
| `actual_duration_seconds`   | `number`                                                                | Yes      | &gt; 0                                                                                     |
| `scrape_interval_seconds`   | `number`                                                                | Yes      | The scrape interval the rule was evaluated with: that of the slowest relevant job. &gt; 0  |
| `scrape_interval_source`    | [scrapeIntervalSource](/reference/schemas/common/#scrapeintervalsource) | Yes      |                                                                                            |
| `job`                       | `string`                                                                | No       | The Prometheus job whose interval limits resolution. Absent when the interval was assumed. |
| `percentile`                | [percentileName](/reference/schemas/phases/#percentilename)             | No       | Rule A: the percentile that lacks samples.                                                 |
| `required_requests`         | `integer`                                                               | No       | Rule A: requests the stage needs for that percentile. ≥ 1                                  |
| `message`                   | `string`                                                                | Yes      |                                                                                            |
